title: Segfault when going to very large line number using :LineNumber

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
- `nvim --version`:
```
NVIM 0.1.5
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
Compilation: /usr/local/Homebrew/Library/Homebrew/shims/super/clang -Wconversion -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=1 -DDISABLE_LOG -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Wno-unused-parameter -Wstrict-prototypes -std=gnu99 -Wvla -fstack-protector-strong -fdiagnostics-color=auto -DINCLUDE_GENERATED_DECLARATIONS -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/build/config -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/src -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/deps-build/usr/include -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/deps-build/usr/include -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/deps-build/usr/include -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/deps-build/usr/include -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/deps-build/usr/include -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/deps-build/usr/include -I/usr/local/opt/gettext/include -I/usr/include -I/usr/include -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/build/src/nvim/auto -I/tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/build/include
Compiled by acid@macbook

Optional features included (+) or not (-): +acl   +iconv    +jemalloc +tui
For differences from Vim, see :help vim-differences
```
- Vim (version: 7.4) behaves differently?  
In regular vim everything works as expected
- Operating system/version:  
macOS, Version 10.12.1
- Terminal name/version:   
iTerm2, Build 3.0.11
- `$TERM`:   
xterm-256color

### Actual behaviour
```
:99999999999999999999999999Assertion failed: (errno != ERANGE), function getdigits, file /tmp/neovim-20160924-3000-16aeltp/neovim-0.1.5/src/nvim/charset.c, line 1743.
[1]    21949 abort      nvim /tmp/newfile
```
### Expected behaviour

Go to the last line of file
### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

Open any file with vim
```
nvim -u NORC /tmp/newfile
```
Try to go to very far line:
```
:999999999999999999999999999
```
